t: NutraClick Refunds | Federal Trade Commission

t: FTC Returns $973K to Consumers Charged for Unwanted Subscriptions for Supplements & Beauty Products | Happi
s: April 28, 2024 - In 2016, Boston-based NutraClick agreed to settle the FTC’s complaint alleging that it lured consumers with “free” samples of supplements and beauty products and then violated the law by charging them a recurring monthly fee without their consent. The settlement required NutraClick to clearly and conspicuously disclose the terms of its recurring membership programs going forward.
